summary: End-to-end validation of P0 fixes from this session: (1) PDF generation rewraps loop markers in production-broken docx-derived templates; (2) @lid hidden-number flow (webhook -> pending banner + tag, manual resolve-lid endpoint, webhook auto-merge, webhook promote). 14/14 backend pytest tests PASS on the preview URL. Frontend banner UI verified visually with Playwright: lid-pending-banner visible on LID ticket, resolve-lid-btn clickable, opens window.prompt, 'Numero Oculto' tag rendered. NO bugs found.
action_items: None for fixes — both P0s are working end-to-end on preview.
Reminder for E1: production deploy at agentcrm.8ip.com.br must be rebuilt for users to receive these fixes (preview only).
critical_code_review_comments:
_auto_wrap_loops correctly strips ALL existing loop markers before re-detecting positions — verified against the real production template /tmp/prod_tpl_63979c6e-f70b-4c95-aee1-d2f10667309d.html which had `

{{#items}}{{/items}}

` (empty pair OUTSIDE the table) and the data row unwrapped. Render produced 0 raw placeholders + 'Servico A','Servico B','Frete rota X' all present + total_value=1.625,00 BRL formatted.
/api/crm/tickets/{id}/resolve-lid correctly delegates to channels_routes._apply_lid_resolution, ensuring promote and merge paths are identical between manual UI flow and microservice webhook.
Webhook lid-resolved -> merge flow correctly DELETES the LID ticket after merging messages dedup'd by wa_message_id and re-points quotes — confirmed via 404 on subsequent GET.
Outgoing /api/crm/tickets/{id}/messages on a NORMAL (non-LID) ticket does NOT crash on lid_jid branch — endpoint accepts request as expected.

MINOR: AtendimentosPage.js uses window.prompt() for resolve-lid which is functional but not modern UX — consider a shadcn dialog with phone-format validation in a future iteration. Not blocking for this P0 fix.
seed_data_creation: Test created TEST_iter46-prefixed tickets/quotes/templates/clients (random UUIDs in phone numbers and lid_jids ensure idempotent re-runs). Tests are self-contained — no manual cleanup required between runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_46.py is a regression for: (a) BeautifulSoup-based _auto_wrap_loops handling broken docx templates with empty marker pairs, (b) full @lid flow end-to-end. Test data is randomized (UUID-based phones and lid_jids) so re-runs work without DB cleanup. Quote templates require `content` field (NOT `html`); quotes require `ticket_id`. The quote response is JSON wrapping `{html, quote}` — render returns content-type application/json with html field, NOT raw HTML. The PDF endpoint returns application/pdf with %PDF header.

{{#items}}{{/items}}
